method: Starting cash is selected by the player at setup: $4M easy, $2M medium, $1M hard/legend. Economy v4 balances Medium around a recommended 16-person roster and a $450k-$600k reserve; difficulty comes from available cash, office pressure, and rival behavior rather than hidden cost multipliers.
Initial draft cost is a one-time full-season roster-rights purchase. The selected wrestler stays on the brand for the whole configured season unless later game systems move/release them.
Removed. There is no signing_bonus_usd field and no hiring formula includes signing bonuses.
After the initial draft, hired talent uses weekly_hire_rate_usd multiplied by selected_contract_weeks. Contract length can differ by offer/tier/scouting outcome.
Matches, promos, and backstage angles retain their segment-level booking costs; those costs are separate from the initial draft full-season roster-rights cost.
Financial values are game-balanced for Next GM and are not claimed as real WWE/AEW pay, contract, or accounting figures.
